 Sebasticook Valley Federal Credit Union will donate to and participate in several community holiday traditions in 2026: the Anah Shriners’ Feztival of Trees in Bangor, the St. Albans Summerfest’s fourth annual Festival of Wreaths in St. Albans, the Sebasticook Valley Chamber of Commerce’s Valley of Trees Festival in Corinna and the Pittsfield Community Garden Club Festival of Trees in Pittsfield. All events bring together families, businesses and organizations to celebrate the holiday season while raising funds that directly benefit their communities.  
 Anah Shriners’ Feztival of Trees : Nov. 19-22 and Nov. 27-29 at the Anah Shrine (1404 Broadway, Bangor). The event features decorated trees and themed gifts donated by local businesses, with raffle proceeds supporting the Anah Shrine’s philanthropic mission. 
 Festival of Wreaths : Nov. 21-22 at the Jonathan Bowman Center for Enrichment (129 Hartland Road, St. Albans). Donated holiday wreaths will be available for purchase, with proceeds benefiting community programs and events. 
 Sebasticook Valley Chamber of Commerce’s Valley of Trees Festival : Dec. 3-6 at the Perfect Fit Community Center ( 42 Stetson Road, Corinna ). Sponsored by Sebasticook Valley FCU, the festival features more than 50 decorated trees and raffle prizes benefiting local causes. 
 Pittsfield Community Garden Club’s Festival of Trees : Dec. 4-6 at Masonic Hall ( 138 Hamilton Terrace, Pittsfield ). The event features decorated trees, raffles and holiday activities, with proceeds supporting community needs and beautification projects. 
 Sebasticook Valley FCU’s tree themes and wreath will be shared in the coming months on their Facebook page. To learn more about Sebasticook Valley Federal Credit Union, visit www.svfcume.com .
